title: TDEE Calculator
seoTitle: Free TDEE Calculator — Calculate Daily Calorie Needs
description: Estimate your Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) from age, sex, weight, height and activity level. Helps plan calorie intake. Private and instant.
intro: Enter your details to calculate BMR and TDEE. Use the result as a starting point for maintenance, weight loss or gain calorie targets.
blurb: Calculate your daily calorie needs (TDEE) based on personal stats and activity.
howItWorks: Enter age, sex, weight in kilograms and height in centimeters.
Click Calculate. BMR uses the Mifflin-St Jeor equation; TDEE multiplies by the activity factor.
examples: A 30-year-old moderately active male at 70 kg / 175 cm needs roughly 2,400–2,600 kcal.
Adjust activity to see how exercise changes daily needs.
Use the maintenance number as a base for a calorie deficit or surplus.

faq.a: BMR is calculated with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, which is widely regarded as accurate for most adults. TDEE applies a standard activity multiplier.
